blocks.text: The agent manager installs the Zscaler Microsegmentation agent service onto your device. It performs initial installation of the agent as well as agent upgrades.
Before you install the agent manager, create a signing certificate to be used for Microsegmentation agents.

A common practice is to generate a new signing certificate named Microsegmentation, which is an intermediate type with the root certificate as its parent. When generating this certificate, set the Client Certificate Type to None.
To learn more, see Creating Certificate Signing Requests for Enrollment (CA) Certificates.
Microsegmentation agents and Zscaler Client Connector are not compatible and should not be installed on the same host.

blocks.item: Download the agent manager installer and view the installation instructions for your operating system (Linux or Windows) by doing either of the following:
Create a new agent group. To learn more, see Configuring Agent Groups.
If an appropriate agent group already exists, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Agent Groups and click the Download icon in the Actions column. To learn more, see About Agent Groups.
See image.

After the agent manager is installed, the manager automatically downloads and installs the agent version selected in the agent group’s version profile. After the agent is downloaded and installed onto your device, the agent initiates a connection to the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE), and the setup is complete.

blocks.text: If the service fails to start or the agent fails to register with the ZTE, it is likely that a firewall or security appliance is interfering with the agent’s outbound mTLS connection. Ensure that this outbound connectivity to Port 443 is permitted, and that this connectivity is not subjected to DPI or similar security measures. To learn more, see Zscaler Config.
To configure automatic upgrades to the agent:

blocks.item: Edit an existing agent group. To learn more, see Editing Agent Groups.
In the selected agent group, expand Agent software updates.
For Version Profile, select the preferred option:
Default: One or two versions older than the Latest release.
Latest: The most recent release.
Custom: Your selection from the historical list of agent version profiles, which includes the Latest release.
Enable Auto Update.
See image.
Complete the remaining steps for editing the agent group.
Click Save.
The agent manager downloads and installs the specified agent version to your device.
